title: PROV export: read-only, faithful for what it represents, honest about the rest
note: Assurance J (D-2026-175). Each mutation lets a model's output read as a derivation, loses an agent, a time, a note, a state or an invalidation, hides what is not represented, exports a history that does not verify, or breaks the names. tests/test_prov_export.py holds each against the Gate C history.

mutations.name: PX1_a_model_s_output_is_a_derivation
mutations.rationale: J: a proposal reads as derived from the model's answer and what it cited

mutations.name: PX2_verification_is_attributed_to_nobody
mutations.rationale: J: who verified a record becomes something it was derived from

mutations.name: PX3_an_event_has_no_agent
mutations.rationale: J: an activity is recorded without who performed it

mutations.name: PX4_an_edge_s_note_is_dropped
mutations.rationale: J: which evidence key or context item a relation was recorded under is lost

mutations.name: PX5_the_time_is_not_the_event_s
mutations.rationale: J: an activity is placed at a time the history does not record

mutations.name: PX6_a_supersession_invalidates_nothing
mutations.rationale: J: a superseded memory is never invalidated in the export

mutations.name: PX7_unread_actions_are_not_disclosed
mutations.rationale: J: what the export leaves out is hidden

mutations.name: PX8_an_unverified_history_is_exported
mutations.rationale: J: a history that does not verify is rendered as an account of what happened

mutations.name: PX9_a_dangling_relation_is_well_formed
mutations.rationale: J: a relation naming nothing declared passes the structural check

mutations.name: PX10_an_entity_has_no_state
mutations.rationale: J: what the history last recorded for a record or memory is not exported

mutations.name: PX11_identifiers_are_not_encoded
mutations.rationale: J: an id holding '%', a space or non-ASCII maps to a name that reads back as another
